findings.title: closeEpoch Can Be Called While Vault Is Paused
findings.description: closeEpoch lacked a whenNotPaused modifier. All user-facing functions correctly include it, but an epoch operator could settle a queued epoch while the vault is paused for a security incident.
findings.resolution: whenNotPaused is now present on closeEpoch (line 447).

findings.title: setSupportedProtocol Can Remove the Active Strategy Protocol ID
findings.description: No guard prevented CONFIG_OPERATOR from calling setSupportedProtocol(activeProtocolId, false). The active adapter would continue working but rebalancing back to that protocol would become impossible until support was re-added.
findings.resolution: ParentVault__CannotRemoveActiveProtocol revert is now present in setSupportedProtocol (line 801).

findings.title: _decodeMetadata Assembly Offsets Contradict the Natspec Comment
findings.description: Natspec describes metadata with a 32-byte length prefix placing workflowId at offset 32. Assembly reads workflowId at offset 0, workflowName at +32, workflowOwner at +42. The assembly is correct; the comment is misleading.
findings.recommendation: Update natspec to: Offset 0 workflowId (bytes32), Offset 32 workflowName (bytes10), Offset 42 workflowOwner (address).

findings.title: No Maximum Epoch Duration Cap
findings.description: MIN_EPOCH_PERIOD = 1 hour is enforced but no MAX_EPOCH_PERIOD exists. An EPOCH_OPERATOR_ROLE holder could delay closing an epoch indefinitely with no user escape hatch for queued deposits and withdrawals.
findings.recommendation: Document intended maximum duration in natspec, or add a user-accessible cancelDeposit/cancelWithdraw path after MAX_EPOCH_PERIOD elapses.

findings.title: _getTVL() Undercounts Vault Balance During CCIP_SEND Recovery
findings.description: When CCIP send fails after adapter withdrawal, withdrawn USDC sits in vault balance under CCIP_SEND recovery mode. _getTVL() does not include s_ccipSendRecovery.amount. No exploit path exists (emergencyDrain reads balanceOf directly; epoch guard blocks new epochs during this window).

acknowledged.title: Recovery functions are deliberately permissionless
acknowledged.note: All recoverFailed*() functions have no role check by design. Documented in codebase.

acknowledged.title: README selector table was outdated
acknowledged.note: README showed old function signatures (closeEpoch(uint256,uint256), completeRebalance(uint256)). Confirmed outdated documentation, not a code issue.

prior_findings_resolved.title: emergencyDrain delay bypass (s_pausedAt reset to 0 after unpause)
prior_findings_resolved.resolution: whenPaused modifier now present on emergencyDrain

prior_findings_resolved.title: _collectPerformanceFee divide-by-zero when tvl = 1 USDC
prior_findings_resolved.resolution: Guard if (fee >= tvl) { return grossPricePerShare; } present at L764
